cross_cutting_notes.trigger: The company gate is evaluated for a sale to anyone other than an SA Permitted Transferee, so both C-CONSENT and the right of first refusal rules (C-ROFR-NOTICE, C-ROFR-RESPONSE, C-ROFR-WINDOW) apply.
cross_cutting_notes.text: Company consent and the right of first refusal are independent gates (SA 4.6). A waiver of the right of first refusal is not consent, and consent is not a waiver of the right of first refusal.

rules.title: Classification as a Transfer
rules.description: A sale or a pledge is a Transfer under both the LPA and the Stockholders' Agreement, whatever the operator calls it. If the operator has classified the proposal as not a Transfer, that classification is rejected and the proposal is evaluated as a Transfer. This never changes the verdict on its own.

rules.title: Document version confirmed
rules.description: The operator must confirm that the evidence gathered was prepared against the current version of the fund, company and side letter documents. If that cannot be confirmed, the evidence may have been prepared against a superseded version and the case must be escalated.

rules.title: Side letter scope
rules.description: The Harbour side letter applies only where the transferor is Harbour Family Office LLC. Rights under it are personal to Harbour and are not available to any other Limited Partner, even one who claims to rely on it.

rules.title: Harbour Transferee exemption from GP consent
rules.description: If the side letter applies and the transferee is a Harbour Transferee, meaning an Affiliate of Harbour or a fund or account managed or advised by Harbour Capital Advisers LLC, the General Partner's consent is not required. This has no effect on the company gate.

rules.title: Harbour deemed consent
rules.description: Where the side letter applies and Harbour has requested the General Partner's consent, that consent is deemed given at the end of the tenth Business Day after receipt of a complete request, if the General Partner has not responded. The clock only starts once the request is complete. Silence is never consent for any other Limited Partner.

rules.title: General Partner consent
rules.description: Every Transfer needs the General Partner's prior written consent, unless the transferee is an LPA Permitted Transferee (an Affiliate, a family trust, or an estate) or a Harbour Transferee under the side letter. Silence is never consent unless the side letter's deemed-consent mechanism applies.

rules.title: Permitted transfer notice to the General Partner
rules.description: A Transfer to an LPA Permitted Transferee needs no General Partner consent, but the General Partner must receive written notice at least five clear Business Days before completion. The earliest permitted completion is the 6th Business Day after receipt.

rules.title: Minimum holding after a partial transfer
rules.description: After a partial Transfer, both the transferor's retained Capital Contribution and the transferee's new Capital Contribution must be at least US$10,000. The transferred amount is the transferor's Capital Contribution multiplied by the fraction Transferred, and the balance remains attributable to the transferor.

rules.title: Beneficial Owner Limit
rules.description: A Transfer must not cause the Partnership to exceed the Beneficial Owner Limit of 95, measured immediately after giving effect to the Transfer. Not applicable to a pledge.

rules.title: Transferee is not a Competitor
rules.description: No Transfer or Indirect Transfer may be made to a Competitor listed in Schedule 2 of the Stockholders' Agreement, or an Affiliate of one, whether or not the Company has consented to it.

rules.title: Company consent
rules.description: Every Indirect Transfer needs the Company's prior written consent, approved by the Board, unless the transferee is an SA Permitted Transferee (an Affiliate, a family trust, or an estate). A Harbour Transferee under the side letter is not an SA Permitted Transferee. The Company's silence is never consent.

rules.title: Permitted transferee notice to the Company
rules.description: An Indirect Transfer to an SA Permitted Transferee needs no Company consent, but the Company must receive written notice, identifying the transferee, at least ten clear Business Days before it takes effect. The earliest permitted completion is the 11th Business Day after receipt.

rules.title: Transfer Notice for the right of first refusal
rules.description: Before an Indirect Transfer by way of sale to anyone other than an SA Permitted Transferee, the Investment Vehicle must deliver a complete Transfer Notice to the Company. The sender bears the burden of proving delivery. Not applicable to a pledge.

rules.title: Company's response to the right of first refusal
rules.description: Once a complete Transfer Notice has been delivered, the Company may exercise its right to buy the whole, and not part, of the interest by written notice within twenty Business Days after receipt, or waive it. A purported partial exercise is not effective under the Agreement and needs legal review.

rules.title: Completion window after the right of first refusal
rules.description: Once the right of first refusal has expired or been waived, completion must occur within 45 Business Days after the end of the exercise period, or after the date of an earlier waiver. After that, a fresh Transfer Notice is required.

rules.title: KYC / AML checks
rules.description: The transferee must complete the General Partner's investor onboarding procedures, including anti-money laundering and know-your-customer checks, to the General Partner's satisfaction.

rules.title: Sanctions screening
rules.description: The transferee must clear sanctions screening to the General Partner's satisfaction. A confirmed hit fails the Transfer outright, with no cure.

rules.title: Accredited investor status
rules.description: The transferee must be an accredited investor as defined in Rule 501(a) of Regulation D. Not applicable to a pledge unless and until the security is enforced.

rules.title: Tax form
rules.description: The transferee must deliver a properly completed IRS Form W-9 or applicable Form W-8. Not applicable to a pledge unless and until the security is enforced.

rules.title: Transfer and Adherence Agreement
rules.description: The transferee must execute and deliver a Transfer and Adherence Agreement. Not applicable to a pledge unless and until the security is enforced.

rules.title: Operator override
rules.description: An operator may record an override of a verdict, with who made it and why. The override is logged in the audit trail but is always rejected: it never changes any rule state or the verdict.
